title: Research: joint rank-five star cuts beat one-sided support capacity
body:
For the fixed P112 parent tagged [7,0], arbitrary joint restrictions of pairing rank at most five have sharp frame capacity 1060/1260. One-sided cuts reach only 1020 or 990. A completeness proof and exact census of 2,667 row planes, 2,667 column planes and 16,129 joint hyperplanes include the unexpected rank-three slices and an attaining witness. This is one parent, not a global decoder or copy-cost bound.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7af6f56bf9ed58eacb3164d7b87b1c92716d8f07/research/p112-joint-rank5-parent/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
